subject: Request: Approval for combined trial top-up credits + one-year discount — CobaltWorks POC
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@cobaltworks.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: CobaltWorks POC — usage spike and ask

Hi Aditya / Monica,

Quick note from the evaluation team: our trial usage spiked this week as we stress-tested the ingestion pipeline. The model performance looks promising, but we exhausted the trial credits faster than expected. We have a procurement window coming up and would like to propose two asks so we can continue the POC without interruption: 1) a short-term trial top-up of $12,000 in credits to complete the remaining testing scenarios, and 2) a conditional discount (we can commit to a 6-month paid contract) — we were thinking ~20% off year-one list if we convert within 30 days of the POC close.

Attached is a short statement of needs and the RFP summary that procurement requested. Could you let us know if Redwood has precedent for combining a one-time credit top-up with a conversion discount? Procurement needs an estimated commercial framework to move internally.

Attachments: [Attachment: CobaltWorks_Statement_of_Needs.pdf (pdf, 420 KB)], [Attachment: Cobalt_RFP.xlsx (xlsx, 85 KB)]

Thanks,
Elena Garcia
Head of Data Platforms | CobaltWorks
elena.garcia@cobaltworks.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@cobaltworks.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: CobaltWorks POC — usage spike and ask

Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Appreciate the heads up on the usage pattern. Short answers: yes, we can often structure a one-time credit top-up paired with a conversion discount on a case-by-case basis, but it requires an approval path up to commercial leadership because it affects both the credit pool and the list-price concession.

Monica / Kim — looping you in to evaluate the ask. Key data we need to route: expected post-conversion ARR, expected monthly throughput (avg tokens / month), and any compliance gating that would extend procurement timelines. Elena — can you confirm the anticipated ARR if they convert to the 6-month contract and whether there is an internal PO timeline?

I'll draft an approval memo once we have those numbers and propose initial concession levels for review.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cobaltworks.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@cobaltworks.com>
Cc: procurement@cobaltworks.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: CobaltWorks POC — usage spike and ask

Aditya / Elena — quick follow from procurement. If Redwood can provide $10k–$12k of one-time credits to finish the validation matrix and a 20% discount on year-one list for a 6-month committed term, procurement will prioritize the PO and aim to route paperwork within two weeks. We have one compliance review that could add a 3–5 day delay but nothing major.

If you need a slightly different split (more discount, smaller credit top-up) say so — we're flexible as long as the overall financial commitment is in line with our internal forecast.

Best,
Samir Patel
Procurement Manager | CobaltWorks
samir.patel@cobaltworks.com
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot: CobaltWorks POC — request for combined credits + discount (exec approval request)

Kim / Vivek — forwarding the thread. Summary / ask: CobaltWorks wants a $12k trial top-up and ~20% first-year discount in exchange for a 6-month commitment and expedited PO. Forecasted 6-month ARR is ~$68k (customer estimate). Commercial impact: credits hit the promotional bucket; discount reduces first-year revenue but materially increases likelihood of conversion and near-term ARR. Proposed concession (my recommendation): one-time $12,000 of credits + 18% discount on year-one invoice. Require exec OK for credits > $10k and any discount >15%. Also asking for a short SLA carveout for the POC period (30 days) to avoid penalty exposure while they ramp.

Attachments: [Attachment: pricing_proposal_v2.pdf (pdf, 95 KB)]

Questions for approval:
- Approve $12k trial credit top-up + 18% first-year discount?
- If not, authorize counter (Vivek: you may want to propose exact fallback).
- If approved, ok to provide a redlined commercial term to procurement and send DocuSign envelope?

Thanks — need a response today if possible to avoid interruption in their testing.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot: CobaltWorks POC — request for combined credits + discount (exec approval request)

Thanks for the concise memo, Aditya. I’m comfortable with approving a combined concession but would like to tighten the structure to protect ARR: approve a one-time $10,000 credit top-up (rather than $12k) and increase the conversion discount to a 20% first-year list concession, conditional on a signed 6-month contract and PO within 30 days. Require legal to confirm standard indemnities and that SLA carveouts are time-limited to the POC window only.

Kim — please confirm this is workable from the revenue ops side and prepare a short amendment / Offer Addendum reflecting: $10k credit, 20% first-year discount, 6-month committed term, docs to sign (DocuSign link below). If procurement agrees, we can proceed.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | VP, Commercial Growth | Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@cobaltworks.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@cobaltworks.com>, procurement@cobaltworks.com
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: CobaltWorks POC concession (one-time credit + discount) — next steps

Elena / Samir — good news: Redwood has approved a combined concession to keep your POC running uninterrupted. Final commercial terms (approved by VP Commercial): one-time $10,000 credit top-up applied to the trial account + 20% off list on year-one invoice, conditional on: signed 6-month contract and PO within 30 days; legal signoff on standard terms; SLA carveout limited to the POC 30-day window.

Action items / next steps:
- Redwood (Kim) will send a short Offer Addendum via DocuSign for signature (links below).
- CobaltWorks to route PO to procurement@redwoodinference.com and sign DocuSign within 30 days.
- Once PO is received, we will apply the $10k account credit (expected within 24 hours).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/EN/recipient?envelopeId=abc123def456
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/67890

Elena — I’ll copy billing once PO is in. Happy to jump on a 15-minute call if you want to walk through the amendment.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
